observations: Official unmodified GNU/Linux ARM64 Node 24.22.2 executes real JavaScript in a non-debuggable Android 15 isolated app/native runner: explicit linux-jit enables anonymous JIT mappings; --jitless passes with default W^X.

Node fs sync/async, access/readlink/fchmod and project artifacts, Unicode ESM/argv, timers/promises, OpenSSL crypto, worker shared Atomics, and real V8 TurboFan optimization passed. Two project Node processes overlapped with distinct isolated UIDs/PIDs and independent same-path files.
Real guest signal delivery/rt_sigreturn, 64 pthread creations/joins, exit_group with syscall-free threads, local pipe/eventfd/epoll, timeout/cancel and all four cleanup barriers passed.
Official @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-rc.1 CLI --version/--help and the unchanged Linux ARM64 glibc require-builtin N-API addon passed; the addon actually invoked a Node builtin.

The final explicitly foregrounded Linux/Node/DSH suite linux-dsh-interactive-final.txt passed 36/36. Original sdk-minimal finite EOF boot and real sequential initialize/shutdown passed without weakening required-plugin activation checks. Earlier 31/31, 30/36 and 34/36 runs remain in history.

Directory support now passes Node sync/async scans and streaming opendir over 181 entries, including UTF-8, empty directories and ENOENT/ENOTDIR. Guest-requested O_NONBLOCK is distinct from the broker's internal nonblocking safeguard.

The final unchanged APK passed four foreground app suites, 69/69: Linux/Node/DSH 36, bundled I/O 12, exec 11 and tools/Lua 10. The earlier seven-group 58/58 baseline is retained separately and is not presented as fully rerun on this final build.

The earlier 27-case CLI run was intentionally interrupted during case 24 import after 23 passing cases; it is not a completed suite or a DSH compatibility failure. Operator-reported cleanup removed only its two orphan environments and one staging file; execution history was preserved.
Earlier hello version expectation was corrected only after verifying the pinned official Debian ELF contains an empty VERSION string.

Network capability probe integrity passed 5/5: isolated service direct TCP socket creation is denied, while manager-provided descriptors support some localhost operations. This does not establish translated Linux guest networking, DNS, UDP, external access, Web or project network isolation.
The outdated O_NONBLOCK rejection assertion remains recorded as an 11/12 failed I/O run. Its revised real dup-shared set/clear and unsupported O_ASYNC checks passed in the final 12/12 rerun.

Final interactive Node tests passed copied-input roundtrip, cumulative overflow rejection, explicit EOF, empty-queue cancellation/deadline, guest-close detection, all four cleanup barriers and project reuse. The preceding 34/36 run's shutdown-boundary expectation failures remain unchanged in history; synchronous cancellation publication and corrected terminal-output boundaries were rerun successfully.

During the earlier linux-dsh-interactive.txt installer wait, foregrounding this app correlated with manager/watchdog progress resuming. Standard dumpsys did not report frozen/cached and the device was awake. Background execution reliability and the precise cause remain unverified.

Official SDK handshake device validation passed with 206 input bytes and zero notifications: initialize returned deepseek-harness-sdk-runtime/0.0.1 while stdin stayed open, then shutdown returned {}, exit zero and full cleanup. No model/tool or external-network request was sent.

Final diagnostics reported no remaining environments or import staging files and required no removals. This cleanup observation is not counted as a seventieth functional test; parent also reported both validation apps retained and no application/runner processes left.
